outlier_rule: absolute log-loss-factor deviation greater than 6 robust MAD
selection_rule: smallest model within one standard error of the best five-fold score
calculix_support: frequency-specific in-phase elastic cards only; CalculiX has no native linear generalized-Maxwell material card in the verified manual
admitted_uses: small-strain frequency-dependent storage sensitivity at 18 C
small-strain shear-relaxation sensitivity only between 6.3662e-06 and 0.159155 s
hard_exclusions: creep beyond the fitted sub-second window
arbitrary temperature, humidity, or print-process transfer
precision loss-modulus prediction because its fit gate failed
